description: This file provides React components and functions related to authentication using the Clerk service. It includes environment variable access, route guards, sign-in/sign-up page components, and an authentication control component.

methods.name: getClerkPublishableKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Clerk publishable key from environment variables, with a warning if missing.

methods.name: AppAuthProvider
methods.description: Wraps children components with ClerkProvider, configuring it with the publishable key and route URLs.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: A route guard component that renders children if signed in, otherwise prompts to sign in.

methods.name: SignInPage
methods.description: Component rendering the SignIn page using Clerk's SignIn component with custom theming.

methods.name: SignUpPage
methods.description: Component rendering the SignUp page using Clerk's SignUp component with custom theming.

methods.name: AuthControls
methods.description: A helper component that shows a sign-in link for signed-out users or a user menu button when signed in.
